name: blender-renderer
description: Digest-pinned Blender renderer runtime for local physical-device scenes

acquisition.license: Blender GPL-3.0-or-later; bundled components have separate license notices; redistribution review pending

targets.unsupported: Blender publishes no official Linux arm64 build; the Blender 5.2 release directory has only blender-5.2.2-linux-x64.tar.xz for Linux.
Blender ships macOS only as the arm64 .dmg disk image, and the pinned renderer profile verifies only the Linux amd64 tree.
Blender publishes Windows x64 and arm64 archives, but the pinned renderer profile verifies only the Linux amd64 tree.

linux.evidence: E3 official Blender 5.2.2 archive inspection; installed profile and render workflow remain unqualified

macos.evidence: The pinned renderer profile (internal/tools/blender-renderer/profile.go) resolves only Linux amd64 and reports unsupported_platform elsewhere.

windows.evidence: The pinned renderer profile (internal/tools/blender-renderer/profile.go) resolves only Linux amd64 and reports unsupported_platform elsewhere.
